reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified E:09 as a heating fault on the known model, confirmed both programmes ran cold, guided a properly isolated (unplugged, panel off) resistance test, interpreted the open-circuit reading correctly and named the integrated heater/circulation pump assembly as the part, then engaged honestly with repair-vs-replace on a 9-year-old machine. Its main failing was never giving even a ballpark part or labour figure despite repeated direct asks, ending on an unhelpful non-answer. Conversation 2 was safe and honest but wasted a turn on eco-programme drying when the customer had already said the dishes were stone cold, never offered the test, never used the known model to identify the heat pump, ignored the cost question entirely and simply handed off to an engineer, leaving the homeowner with far less actionable information.
